title: Managing a Team Through Layoffs
paragraphs: Tasked with implementing company-wide layoffs that would eliminate nearly a third of his department, Karim faced the genuinely uncomfortable responsibility of delivering difficult news to employees he had personally worked alongside for years.

Rather than distancing himself emotionally from the process, as several colleagues in similar positions had done, he made a point of speaking with each affected employee individually rather than relying solely on group announcements.

This approach required considerably more emotional energy and time than a more detached process would have, but Karim believed employees deserved direct, honest communication rather than impersonal, generic notifications.

Months later, several employees who had left the company specifically thanked Karim for how he had handled their departure, noting that his compassion during a difficult situation had made an already painful process somewhat more bearable.
